name: compute_manager
title: Compute Manager
description: Run and manage containerized workloads (ECS/Fargate-style task API) on workers selected by the conductor.

name: queue_manager
title: Queue Manager
description: Message queues with visibility timeout, dead-letter semantics, and async workers (SQS-like).

name: schedule_manager
title: Schedule Manager
description: Cron and one-shot schedules; dispatches to HTTP webhooks or queue_manager (EventBridge-like).

name: network_manager
title: Network Manager
description: Project-scoped Docker networks and isolation labels (VPC-lite).

name: logs_manager
title: Logs Manager
description: Ingest, store, and query structured logs from services and workers.

name: metrics_manager
title: Metrics Manager
description: Scrape or receive metrics; expose Prometheus format; optional alert routing.

name: iam_manager
title: IAM Manager
description: Roles, policies, and API keys for users and services (IAM-shaped authZ).

name: secrets_manager
title: Secrets Manager
description: Store and retrieve secrets; integrate with key_manager for envelope encryption when configured.

name: security_manager
title: Security Manager
description: Security posture checks, policy evaluation hooks, and integration points for scanners.

name: balancer_manager
title: Balancer Manager
description: Layer-7 routing hints and health-aware backends; complements conductor LoadBalancer.

name: tunnel_manager
title: Tunnel Manager (Cloudflare)
description: Manage Cloudflare Tunnels (cloudflared) for safe ingress without opening firewall ports.

name: domain_manager
title: Domain Manager
description: DNS and domain records; designed for Cloudflare (and pluggable providers).

name: webhook_manager
title: Webhook Manager
description: Register outbound webhooks, signing secrets, retries, and delivery logs.

name: email_manager
title: Email Manager
description: Send transactional email via pluggable providers (SMTP, Zoho, etc.).

name: sms_manager
title: SMS Manager
description: SMS delivery via pluggable providers for alerts and OTP flows.

name: slack_manager
title: Slack Manager
description: Post messages and alerts to Slack workspaces via incoming webhooks or API.

name: auth_manager
title: Auth Manager
description: Optional external auth federation hooks; complements conductor JWT users.

name: analytics_manager
title: Analytics Manager
description: Event ingestion and rollups for product analytics (privacy-aware, self-hosted).

name: cdn_manager
title: CDN Manager
description: CDN configuration and cache rule management (provider-pluggable).

name: cicd_manager
title: CI/CD Manager
description: Trigger and track build/deploy pipelines; integrates with worker deployments.

name: code_as_infra
title: Code as Infra
description: Declarative stacks and revisions (IaC-lite) applied via conductor/worker.

name: crawler_manager
title: Crawler Manager
description: Scheduled fetch/crawl jobs with rate limits and storage hooks.

name: host_manager
title: Host Manager
description: Inventory and metadata for physical/virtual hosts backing workers.

name: mcp_manager
title: MCP Manager
description: Register and proxy MCP tool servers for AI/agent workflows.

name: api_manager
title: API Manager
description: Click-to-build or template-driven HTTP APIs routed through conductor.

name: app_manager
title: App Manager
description: Manage mobile/web app build artifacts and deployment hooks (RN-friendly).

name: ai_manager
title: AI Manager
description: Model endpoints, routing, and quotas for local or remote inference.

name: system_manager
title: System Manager
description: OS update windows and maintenance orchestration on workers (careful: privileged ops).

name: worker_manager
title: Worker Manager
description: Fleet-level worker operations beyond single-node worker agent (bulk actions, labels).

name: registry_manager
title: Container Registry Manager
description: Private OCI registry integration (Harbor, Docker Distribution, etc.) for worker images.
